title: Feature Evolution and Migration during Vision Transformer Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.20134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a novel view on feature evolution in Vision Transformers (ViTs) by visualizing the training process over two dimensions -- network depth (layer) and training time (epochs). We employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to extract candidate sparse features from CLS-token representations and compare their activation profiles across epoch--layer pairs. This allows us to study feature-level dynamics that are not directly visible from representation-level similarity measures. Furthermore, we demonstrate how this framework of feature evolution allows us to describe feature migration, the change in the layer where a feature is most detectable during training. Our experiments show that migration is concentrated early in training, occurs more often toward earlier layers than toward deeper layers, and declines as feature organization stabilizes. translated_title: 视觉Transformer训练中的特征演化与迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20134v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们通过可视化训练过程在两个维度——网络深度（层）和训练时间（轮次）——上的表现，提出了一种关于视觉Transformer（ViTs）中特征演化的新视角。我们采用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）从CLS令牌表示中提取候选稀疏特征，并比较它们在轮次-层对上的激活模式。这使我们能够研究在表示级相似性度量中无法直接观察到的特征级动态。此外，我们展示了这一特征演化框架如何帮助我们描述特征迁移，即训练过程中特征最可检测层的变化。我们的实验表明，迁移集中在训练早期，更多地向较早层而非较深层发生，并随着特征组织的稳定而减少。我们进一步发现，较深层比浅层更早且更强烈地稳定。
tldr: 本文通过稀疏自编码器可视化ViT训练中的特征演化，发现特征迁移集中于早期训练且倾向于向浅层移动，深层比浅层更早稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper visualizes feature evolution in ViT training using sparse autoencoders, finding that feature migration concentrates early in training and shifts toward shallower layers, with deeper layers stabilizing earlier and more strongly.
